headline: Bubbeep
title: Bubbeep | Grass and Water Healer | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Bubbeep is a Grass and Water support Aniimo found around Crescent Bay in the Whisperwake Isles. It turns algae into floating bubbles, and it can swim. Baa Bubble Wave shields allies along its path, while Ripples of Floating Duckweed heals your team in a moving area. Bubbeep evolves into Glameep, a stage three healer. Want a healer for your team? Comment below!
description: How to get Bubbeep in Aniimo: a Grass and Water healer found around Crescent Bay in the Whisperwake Isles. It shields and heals allies and evolves into Glameep. Checked on aniimo.gg and Aniimo Wiki.
